datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Malawi administrative units. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity. Data were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for medium-term projections across multiple scenarios in 2013.
